title: Family Caregiving in an Aging America
discussion_signal: Pew's post invites caregivers to describe the lived burden of caring for older parents. Comments add concrete accounts of stress, reduced social life, memory-care tradeoffs, and a debate about whether employer benefits should distinguish eldercare from childcare.
linked_research_question: How does unpaid family caregiving function as social infrastructure while redistributing time, work, money, health, and social costs onto households?
limits: Comments are volunteered experiences, not a representative sample
The employer-benefit proposal is a commenter suggestion
